= The APF Peer-Reviewed Foresight Literature Canon: 1000 Seminal Journal Articles =

This master catalog curates 1000 peer-reviewed research papers from the core foresight journals: ''Futures'', ''Technological Forecasting and Social Change'', ''Journal of Futures Studies'', ''Foresight'', ''European Journal of Futures Research'', ''World Futures Review'', and ''Futures & Foresight Science''.
